svg.title: Speech: Ears and a Voice
svg.desc: Top lane, speech recognition or speech to text: audio, live, a single file or an archive, goes to an acoustic model that turns audio into phonemes, then a language model that turns phonemes into words, giving text; diarization separates speakers and speech translation changes language. Bottom lane, speech synthesis or text to speech: text is marked up with SSML, XML that controls pauses, rate, pitch and pronunciation, and a neural voice speaks it as audio. If you need specific fields such as caller name, number and action from recordings, use a Content Understanding audio analyzer instead of just a transcript.
svg.text: Recognition turns audio into text; synthesis turns text into audio, shaped by SSML.
Caller name, number, requested action: use a Content Understanding audio analyzer (1.14)
